claim.claim-text: 2. The method of claim 1, wherein the application further transmits a software fingerprint of the mobile device to the authentication server, the method further comprising: determining, by the authentication server, that the software fingerprint matches a stored software fingerprint of the mobile device associated with the account.

3. The method of claim 2, wherein the authentication server further determines to process the transaction without authenticating login credentials for the account based on the determination that the software fingerprint matches a stored software fingerprint of the mobile device.

4. The method of claim 1, further comprising: transmitting, by the authentication server, the instruction to the virtual account number server based on the determination to process the transaction without authenticating the login credentials for the account via the application.
5. The method of claim 1, the known location comprising at least one of a home location or a work location associated with the account.
6. The method of claim 1, further comprising:

receiving, by the virtual account number server from an account database, an account holder name of the account and an address associated with the account; and transmitting, by the virtual account number server, the account holder name and address to the merchant server, the merchant server further to process the transaction using the account holder name and address.
7. The method of claim 6, further comprising:
8. The method of claim 6, further comprising:
9. The method of claim 1, wherein the application receives the encrypted data according to near-field communication (NFC) and the EMV standard.
10. The method of claim 1, further comprising:

receiving, by the authentication server, a device identifier of the mobile device from the application; and determining, by the authentication server, that the device identifier is associated with the account.
11. The method of claim 1, wherein the virtual account number is different than an account number associated with the contactless card.
12. The method of claim 1, further comprising: generating, by the merchant server, the transaction identifier for the transaction.
13. A computer program comprising instructions which, when the program is executed by a system, cause the system to carry out the method as claimed in any preceding claim.
14. A system comprising means to perform a method as claimed in any preceding claim.
